items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: Well, Alvin Alcorn and Herman Franklin and Joe Phillip was the featured men.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know him very well.

And he's playing here now with Papa Salastain's band. Well, Alvin Alcorn and Herman Franklin and Joe Phillip was the featured men. Sidney just played his horn. He sat there and played. He never did stand up. He sat there and played. He could read. He could read anything you put for him. He sat there and played. When he got time for the solo, either Alvin Alcorn or Joe Phillip would stand up.
Sidney never did take solo? Never did take solo. Never did solo, but he could play. How was his tone? Was it very powerful?
